property_summary: After any single call to play() that does not trigger a win (random != 0), the pot must equal the number of plays * TICKET_AMOUNT; the mutant increments pot by 1 instead of TICKET_AMOUNT, so after one such call pot becomes 1, which violates this invariant.
change_summary: Change 'pot += msg.value;' to 'pot += 1;' so the pot grows by 1 instead of the ticket amount.
